_comment: Beex Command Deck roster — HOT-SWAPPABLE. The weekly scout agent regenerates this file; deck.py reloads it on every run. Adding a provider = one JSON entry, zero code. daily_quota null = no daily cap (subscription limits handled by cooldowns). Set enabled=false to bench a provider without deleting it.

claude.strengths: strongest agentic coder; your Max sub; save for deep work

gemini.strengths: free workhorse IF your OAuth still works — free tier reportedly forced to Antigravity CLI June 18 2026; deck routes around it automatically if dead

grok.strengths: SuperGrok sub; Grok 4.5; most permissive frontier model; open-sourced CLI Jul 15

codex.strengths: works with a FREE ChatGPT account since 2026 (local tasks, small rolling quota) — frontier second opinions at $0
codex.auth: codex login (free ChatGPT account is fine)

nim.strengths: free 40 RPM; huge OSS models (Kimi K2.5, DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5.1); the volume engine

groq.strengths: 1,000 req/day/model, fastest inference anywhere; token/day caps burn fast in agents

github-models.strengths: 50/day GPT-5-class one-shots, but 8K-in/4K-out — planning & review ONLY, never agentic

openrouter.strengths: many free models behind one key; 50/day free -> 1,000/day after ONE-TIME $10 (then set daily_quota to 950); roster rotates weekly

zai.strengths: GLM-4.7-Flash free ~1k/day; real coding ability; limits shift often

mistral.strengths: 1B tokens/MONTH free (Experiment tier); requires data-training opt-in — do NOT send private code

cerebras.strengths: 1M tokens/day free, insanely fast — but 8K context cap kills agent use; enable for short bulk only

deepseek.strengths: NOT free but pennies: $0.14/M in, $0.014/M cached, $0.28/M out; 1M ctx; 2x price at Beijing peak hours; old deepseek-chat model IDs died Jul 24
deepseek.auth: paid key at platform.deepseek.com (~$2 lasts weeks)

ollama.strengths: free, unlimited, private; GLM-4.7-Flash (30B-A3B) is the current best small local coder; also try qwen3-coder-next, gpt-oss:20b

ollama-uncensored.strengths: adult-lane writer, 100% local/private. Alternatives on ollama.com/library: dolphin-mistral, dolphin-mixtral, huihui_ai abliterated builds (check current tags). Nothing ever leaves your machine.

venice.strengths: privacy-first uncensored cloud API (paid; verify current models/pricing at venice.ai). Enable ONLY if you accept cloud for adult text; adult lane stays local-first regardless
